selection_constraints: Use only task statement, starter API, source metadata, and public test count for membership.
Do not use private test outcomes, model outputs, or prior P3/P5 per-task results.
Each selected row must declare execution_mode as function or stdin and match the source row.
Every method uses the source row's declared execution mode.

groups.name: simple_single_stage
groups.selection_rule: Choose only previously unrun holdout-30 rows with one dominant transformation and no necessary helper boundary.

groups.name: medium_multi_stage
groups.selection_rule: Choose newly fetched, unscored rows with multiple transformations but materially coupled stages or an ambiguous helper interface.

groups.name: hard_naturally_decomposable
groups.selection_rule: Choose newly fetched, unscored hard stdin rows with at least two explicit stages and independently specifiable helper contracts.
